title: Website and repository skills are both version 0.8.6 but differ
detail: 35 lines differ; installed copies can't tell which text they have.

title: The agent-skills index publishes the website skill's digest, not the repository's
detail: Agents that verify the digest get the website text, which lacks rules present in the repository copy.

title: Docs and live tool describe omitted optional coverages differently
detail: The docs say only the options passed are priced; the live tool description says an omitted um/medpay keeps each carrier's own default. In the docs' own auto example, Mercury's lines include MEDPAY and Travelers' don't, though the request named neither. A comparison can then mix coverages. The repository skill now sends medpay 5000 in its starting point, which narrows this.

evidence.quote: Nothing is priced at a server default: the options you pass are the ones priced.
An omitted OPTIONAL axis (`um`, `medpay`, `coverage_d`) keeps each carrier's own default

title: Estimates are monthly; confirmations print a term premium
detail: quote_insurance returns monthly prices and accepts a term of 6 or 12 months; live confirmations return the carrier page's own term premium. How the monthly figure relates to a term (and to paying in full) isn't stated, so an agent comparing an estimate with a confirmation has to convert on its own.

evidence.quote: Policy term in months, 6 or 12. Many carriers price six months only; each quote says its term

title: live_carrier_quotes progress field is named two ways in the docs
detail: The response table names `eta_seconds_remaining`; the in-progress example returns `eta_seconds`. A client written from the table would miss the value.

title: Priced results use structuredContent only, leaving the text channel empty
detail: MCP 2025-06-18 says a tool returning structured content SHOULD also return the serialized JSON in a text block. Clients that read only text (Foresee runs a separate Cursor host for this) see nothing.

evidence.quote: A priced result arrives entirely in `structuredContent`; `content` is empty.
